staticText: Local-first lookup over exactly 106 app-local, unverified English-Amharic draft phrase rows in 14 categories. Displays Ethiopic spelling plus approximate editorial romanisation and pronunciation cues. The table has no entry-level provenance or qualified Amharic sign-off, is not a complete dictionary, and makes no accuracy, dialect or reversible-transliteration promise. Local search, quiz, copy, TXT and print-to-PDF do not send or persist raw user text. Optional cloud translation is a separate external-service flow that stays disabled until explicit page-session consent and must not be used for sensitive text. Confirm every important row with a qualified Amharic translator.
